write_up: Your resume tells a coherent story from object storage at Nimbus Cloud to ledger and settlement leadership at Brightline Payments. A recruiter can see the technical work, but the latest role leaves some questions about how large the team is and what the ledger redesign changed.

The fraud scoring line is your best model: it names the pipeline, the tools, the payment events and the latency it achieved. Your progression at Brightline is easy to follow, and the staff title is backed by architecture, incident leadership and mentoring.

Start with the ledger and settlement team, then give the redesign a result a recruiter can compare. Add the reconciliation measures if you have them. You don't need a number on every line; the goal is to make your biggest work as concrete as the fraud pipeline.
